name: Architecture Owner (ArOw)
one_liner: Solution architect who guides architecture collaboratively and still delivers like any member.
purpose: The Architecture Owner (ArOw) is the solution architect responsible for the Agile Project Core Team's architecture decisions, facilitating the creation and evolution of the overall solution design while considering existing or planned investments in other information systems. Because architecture can generate critical project risks, the ArOw must ensure the team mitigates them. Although typically the senior developer on the team, it is not a hierarchical position to which other members report.

fields.f: Acts as an ATeM in ceremonies
fields.what: In the Daily Stand-up, Iteration Review and Retrospective the Architecture Owner acts like a regular Agile Team Member.
fields.pollux: Stands up with the team every morning, with no special standing.

traps: ArOw is not the Architecture Office; it aligns the team with the AO's guidelines.
ArOw is not a manager — no team member reports to the Architecture Owner.
ArOw is Responsible for the Architecture Overview; the Project Manager is Accountable.
In stand-up, review and retrospective the ArOw is just another Agile Team Member.
Architecture risks go to the TeCo and PM, not only into the team's board.
